I have built your minimal, high-contrast Video Editing Portfolio Website.

**Live Preview:** https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/d8a5c828-17e5-4bfe-a9fa-c637b9c7e15c/a05315bd6debc3e8f1f7ea63/

### What Was Built

- **Design & Color System** ([styles.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/styles.css)):
  - Pure white (`#FFFFFF`) background with crisp black (`#000000`) headings, body text, and interactive buttons.
  - Subtle purple (`#6D28D9`) used sparingly for the availability indicator, section eyebrows, timeline scrubber thumb, focus rings, and copy confirmation states—without gradients or visual clutter.
  - Clean `Inter` sans-serif typography across all headings and UI controls, strictly upright (`font-style: normal` enforced globally with no italics or cursive).
  - Black buttons with white text and slightly rounded corners (`6px` via `--radius-md`), with zero pill-shaped buttons.

- **Layout & Sections** ([index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html)):
  - **Hero Section**: Introduces you as a Video Editor, includes a direct Discord copy button (`rayz_69`), and features a 16:9 Showreel card.
  - **Portfolio Section**: Filterable video editing showcase (`All`, `Commercial`, `Documentary`, `Music Video`, `Brand Film`, `Creator`) with 16:9 preview frames, duration badges, and role metadata.
  - **About Me Section**: Concise overview of your editorial philosophy, core disciplines, and editing toolkit (`DaVinci Resolve Studio`, `Adobe Premiere Pro`, `After Effects`, `Frame.io`).
  - **Contact Section**: Highlights your Discord ID **`rayz_69`** with a one-click copy button alongside a project brief form that formats and copies client inquiries to the clipboard for quick Discord messaging.

- **Interactive Screening Player & Animations** ([script.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/script.js)):
  - Clicking the showreel or any portfolio card opens a screening modal with Play/Pause (`Space` shortcut), a scrubbable timeline with cut markers, live 24 FPS timecode, and project specs. You can drop real `.mp4` paths or URLs into the `videoUrl` field in `PROJECTS` inside [script.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/script.js#L9-L147) to switch any card to native HTML5 video playback.
  - Scroll-reveal animations using `IntersectionObserver` fade elements in smoothly with opacity, vertical lift, and subtle blur (`filter: blur(8px)` to `0`).

- **Portfolio Preview Assets** (`/home/agent/workspace/assets/`):
  - [showreel-hero.jpg](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/showreel-hero.jpg), [project-commercial.jpg](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/project-commercial.jpg), [project-documentary.jpg](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/project-documentary.jpg), [project-music.jpg](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/project-music.jpg), [project-brand.jpg](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/project-brand.jpg), and [project-creator.jpg](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/project-creator.jpg).

### Verification

- Checked `script.js` syntax via `node --check /home/agent/workspace/script.js`.
- Served the site locally with Python `http.server` and confirmed HTTP `200` responses for `/`, `/styles.css`, `/script.js`, and all six `assets/*.jpg` files.
- Verified CSS `border-radius` declarations and HTML/CSS constraints (`#FFFFFF` background, `#000000` buttons, no italics, no pill shapes, and `rayz_69` in the contact section).
